name: Inner Mongolia
native: 内蒙古自治政府 (Nèi Měnggǔ zìzhì zhèngfǔ)

predecessors.name: Inner Mongolian People S Republic
predecessors.text: the Chahar, Xilingol and Siziwang areas of the 1945 Inner Mongolian People's Republic (9 September to 6 November 1945), whose provisional government Ulanhu dissolved in October 1945 before launching…

predecessors.name: Manchukuo
predecessors.text: the Xing'an and Hulunbuir lands of Manchukuo, which the Soviet and Mongolian forces occupied in 1945

successors.name: People's Republic of China
successors.text: the five leagues of 1947 (Hulunbuir, Nanwenmuren, Hinggan, Xilin Gol and Chahar), '34 banners and cities and 1 county', 538,000 km2 and about 2 million people: Hulunbuir together with the Nanwenmuren…

ledger.x: 1 May 1947: the Inner Mongolian Autonomous Government is proclaimed at Wangyemiao with Ulanhu as chairman.
1 October 1949: the Communist-led autonomous government becomes part of the People's Republic.

certainty.note: The zh page counts leagues, banners and an area but draws no line; the drawn edge follows discs round the leagues' seats and the steppe frontier is soft throughout.
